tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Fresh original standalone VIEWER-RIGHT presentation pose of the EXACT adopted Florida Panther attached as sole identity/style/body reference, not an edit target. Draw one complete character on genuinely transparent1254x1254canvas, same camera, head/torso/foot size and standing placement as the reference. Keep same golden/tan warm paper paint, cream round muzzle and belly/chest, brown ear rims, three whisker lines each cheek, white eye shapes with plain brown pupils, original closed curved friendly mouth and big brown nose. The SINGLE long curved TAIL MUST REMAIN ON VIEWER RIGHT exactly as reference, behind the arm, with its original dark tip. Do NOT mirror the character or put tail on viewer left. Present toward VIEWER RIGHT using the forepaw on viewer-right extending a little outward, original rounded fingerless paw end without a human thumb. Viewer-left forepaw stays relaxed down. Eyes glance right, head mostly forward. Two short arms, two grounded feet, one tail only. Preserve natural torso length and head level, no squat redesign. All original colour/whisker details retained. Absolutely no text, labels, ray/symbol effects, extra objects, highlights, clothes, ground, shadows, extra/missing/disconnected parts, cream palm pads or drawn new fingers. Clean intentional soft painted paper, crisp warm brown contours, no bleeding or muddy paint.
